tools.name: help
tools.title: EZYOURLIFE help & tool guide
tools.description: Returns a full guide to every EZYOURLIFE MCP tool with example usage. Call this first if unsure what's available.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.title: Get EZYOURLIFE credit balance
tools.description: Returns the signed-in user's free + paid credit balance on EZYOURLIFE.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.title: List EZYOURLIFE AI apps
tools.description: Search or list AI apps in the EZYOURLIFE catalog. Optional query filters by name/description/category.

query.description: Free-text search across name, description, category.

tools.name: get_tool_link
tools.title: Get a direct link to an EZYOURLIFE tool
tools.description: Returns a direct URL to open a specific EZYOURLIFE AI app in the browser. Use for iframe/UI-only tools that can't run over MCP (e.g. Startup Analyser, Video Generator, Notebook).

tools.name: list_shortcuts
tools.title: List text-expansion shortcuts
tools.description: List the signed-in user's EZYOURLIFE text-expansion shortcuts (key → value). These sync to the browser extension and Speedy Notebook.

tools.name: save_shortcut
tools.title: Save a text-expansion shortcut
tools.description: Create or update an EZYOURLIFE text-expansion shortcut. The `key` (e.g. 'mtg') will expand to `value` in the browser extension and Speedy Notebook.

value.description: The text this shortcut expands to.

logic.description: Optional note describing when to use this shortcut.

tools.name: delete_shortcut
tools.title: Delete a text-expansion shortcut
tools.description: Remove an EZYOURLIFE text-expansion shortcut by its key.

tools.name: append_notebook_entry
tools.title: Append to Speedy Notebook
tools.description: Append a note to the signed-in user's Speedy Notebook on EZYOURLIFE. A timestamped heading is added before the content.

content.description: Note content (HTML or plain text). Appended to the notebook.

heading.description: Optional short heading for the note.

tools.name: add_meet_nudge_contact
tools.title: Add a Meet Nudge contact
tools.description: Add a networking contact to the signed-in user's Meet Nudge CRM on EZYOURLIFE.

tools.name: list_meet_nudge_contacts
tools.title: List Meet Nudge contacts
tools.description: List the signed-in user's Meet Nudge networking contacts. Optional search by name/business/email.

tools.name: analyze_prompt
tools.title: Analyze & improve a prompt (PromptMaster)
tools.description: Rewrites a user's prompt using EZYOURLIFE PromptMaster (Gemini). Returns an improved version plus rationale. Charges the user's credits per catalog pricing.

prompt.description: The prompt to analyze and improve.

goal.description: Optional: what the user wants the improved prompt to achieve.

tools.name: list_my_creations
tools.title: List my AI creations
tools.description: Recent items the signed-in user has generated on EZYOURLIFE (images, videos, docs, etc.).

tools.name: list_bulk_jobs
tools.title: List my bulk processing jobs
tools.description: Recent bulk-mode processing jobs run by the signed-in user on EZYOURLIFE.

tools.name: submit_tool_request
tools.title: Request a new EZYOURLIFE tool
tools.description: Submits a request for EZYOURLIFE to build a new custom AI tool (typical turnaround 24-48h).

tool_description.description: Describe the tool you want built.

tools.name: dev_get_standards
tools.title: EzYourLife developer rules and categories
tools.description: Returns the rules and the conversion playbook for putting an app on EzYourLife in any form (AI Studio export, React/Vue/Svelte or other multi-file project, an app built in Claude), the step-by-step publishing flow, and the list of valid store categories. Call this first when putting an app on EzYourLife, every session.

tools.name: dev_next_step
tools.title: What to do next for a developer app
tools.description: Tells you the exact next action for an app, from where it stands now (nothing uploaded, AI step missing, not test-run yet, listing or screenshots missing, ready for the preview, with the team). Call it after every change and when unsure; do what it says, and stop to ask the developer only for items it lists under needs_developer. It runs the checks itself. It never shows a price: the cost is worked out by EzYourLife and only the admin sees and sets the price.

tools.name: dev_create_app
tools.title: Create a developer app on EzYourLife
tools.description: Creates a new app for the signed-in developer with an empty first version. The slug becomes the address /tool/dev-<slug> and cannot be changed later.

slug.description: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. 'tip-splitter'.

name.description: The app's name in the store.

tools.name: dev_list_my_apps
tools.title: List my EzYourLife developer apps
tools.description: Lists the signed-in developer's apps with their kind (AI app or file app), latest version, its state and whether the app is live. Call before creating an app, so updates never make duplicates.

tools.name: dev_save_app
tools.title: Save a file app's store listing
tools.description: FILE APPS: saves the store listing (name, descriptions, category, charge options, promo and so on) to the app's editable version. The app itself is sent as a whole build folder with dev_import_project or dev_get_upload_link; a hand-made single HTML file is not accepted. For an AI app use dev_save_ai_app instead. If the latest version is live, this starts the next version; the live app does not change until that version is approved. Saving clears earlier check results.

similar_note.description: How this app is different from the similar apps dev_check_similar or dev_run_checks found, in one or two sentences from the developer's own words. Required (20+ characters) when similar apps exist. The admin reads it next to those apps and decides.

label.description: Short name, e.g. 'Quick split' or 'Export pack'.

kind.description: per_use = a level of use. money = something the developer would sell for rupees (set inr).

inr.description: Rupee price the developer wants. Only for kind 'money'. The team converts it to credits.

note.description: What the person gets, in plain words.

charge_options.description: Every way the developer wants to charge, so the team can price each one. Replaces the earlier list. Pass [] to clear. The team, not you, decides the credits.

headline.description: The page's main line, for example 'Split any bill in seconds'.

tagline.description: One sentence on what the visitor gets.

highlights.description: 3 to 6 things the app does well. Real features only.

promo.description: The app's own promo page. Required. No ratings, reviews, customer quotes or claims the app does not back up.

listing.description: Store listing fields to set. Leave out any field you are not changing.

tools.name: dev_check_similar
tools.title: Check for similar apps before building
tools.description: Looks for apps already in the EzYourLife store (or waiting for review) that do about the same job as the one being built, by name and one-line description. Call it BEFORE converting the app, and again if the name or description changes. If it finds any: tell the developer which ones, ask whether theirs really is different, and if so get a one or two sentence note in their own words (how it differs) and pass it as listing.similar_note. The team reads that note next to the similar apps and decides; it is not an automatic block.

short_description.description: The one-line description of what it does.

app_id.description: The developer's own app, if it exists already (so it is not compared with itself).

tools.name: dev_save_ai_app
tools.title: Save an AI app's definition and listing
tools.description: Saves an AI app: its definition (screen type, fields, AI instructions) and/or its store listing, to the editable version. The app then runs on EzYourLife's own screens and AI and is charged in credits per use; there is no code and no file. An app becomes an AI app by saving a definition while it has no live version (an app that is live as a file app, or live as an AI app, keeps its kind: create a new app instead). If the latest version is decided, this starts the next version; the live app does not change until it is approved. Saving clears earlier check results. If the definition is wrong the answer says exactly what to fix.

engine.description: doc = a form in, a written result out. chat = a conversation (optionally over documents the visitor pastes). vision = photos or scanned pages in, written result out.

intro.description: One sentence under the app's title: what the visitor gets.

steps.description: How it works, up to 4 very short steps.

key.description: Short id, letters/numbers/underscore. Defaults to the label. Referenced in 'sample' and in the instructions.

label.description: What the visitor reads above the box.

type.description: text, textarea (long), number, money (rupees), date, select (one of options), chips (tap one of options), rows (a small table: set columns).

half.description: Put two short fields side by side.

defaultRows.description: For type rows: starting rows keyed by column key.

profile.description: Prefill from the visitor's saved EzYourLife business profile.

fields.description: doc only: what the visitor fills in.

sample.description: doc only: a realistic example keyed by field key, for the 'Try an example' button.

refineChips.description: doc only: quick edits, e.g. 'Shorter', 'More formal'.

welcome.description: chat only: the assistant's first message.

documents.description: chat only: let the visitor paste documents as context.

instructionsLabel.description: vision only: label for the optional note box.

system.description: The AI's standing instructions: role, rules, tone, output format (Markdown). Stored on the server, never shown to visitors. EzYourLife adds its own safety rules after yours.

task.description: doc and vision: what to produce from the inputs each time, e.g. 'Write the reply using the inputs above.'

model.description: flash (default, careful) or lite (cheaper, short simple jobs). No other model exists.

maxTokens.description: Longest answer. As small as the output allows (default 4096).

maxContext.description: chat only: characters of pasted documents.

spec.description: The complete definition. Leave out to change only the listing.

similar_note.description: How this app is different from the similar apps dev_check_similar or dev_run_checks found, in one or two sentences from the developer's own words. Required (20+ characters) when similar apps exist. The admin reads it next to those apps and decides.

label.description: Short name, e.g. 'Quick split' or 'Export pack'.

kind.description: per_use = a level of use. money = something the developer would sell for rupees (set inr).

inr.description: Rupee price the developer wants. Only for kind 'money'. The team converts it to credits.

note.description: What the person gets, in plain words.

charge_options.description: Every way the developer wants to charge, so the team can price each one. Replaces the earlier list. Pass [] to clear. The team, not you, decides the credits.

headline.description: The page's main line, for example 'Split any bill in seconds'.

tagline.description: One sentence on what the visitor gets.

highlights.description: 3 to 6 things the app does well. Real features only.

promo.description: The app's own promo page. Required. No ratings, reviews, customer quotes or claims the app does not back up.

listing.description: Store listing fields to set. Leave out any field you are not changing.

tools.name: dev_save_ai_step
tools.title: Save the AI step of a file app
tools.description: FILE APPS that use AI (for example an AI Studio export that called Gemini from its own server): saves the AI step, the instructions the store runs on its own AI keys when the page calls window.ezyourlife.ai(inputs). The app's own code must call that function instead of its old server call, and keep its own fallback. Upload the app first (dev_import_project or the upload link; a new upload keeps the saved step). The visitor is charged credits per AI result only; the app opens free. EzYourLife works out the cost itself and the team sets the price: the developer does not set one and is not shown one. Pass spec: null to remove the step. Saving clears earlier check results. Next: dev_test_run with a realistic example.

key.description: Letters, numbers, underscore: the key the page sends.

label.description: What the visitor typed or chose, in words.

inputs.description: Every answer the page sends to window.ezyourlife.ai(inputs). The team reads this to see which of the visitor's answers reach the AI.

fallback.description: What the page shows when the AI is unavailable or the visitor has no credits. The page must really do this (keep the app's own fallback code).

system.description: The AI's standing instructions, moved here from the app's old server code: role, rules, tone, what it must never invent. Stored on the server, never shown to visitors.

task.description: What to produce from the inputs each time, and the exact layout of the answer. For JSON: every field name and what it holds.

model.description: flash (default) or lite (cheaper, short simple jobs).

maxTokens.description: Longest answer. As small as the output allows.

json.description: true when the page expects an object: window.ezyourlife.ai then resolves with the parsed JSON object. false: it resolves with text.

anyOf.description: The AI step of a file app.

spec.description: The complete AI step, or null to remove it.

tools.name: dev_test_run
tools.title: Test-run an AI app with the real AI
tools.description: Runs the saved definition (or, for a file app, its AI step) of the app's latest version once, on EzYourLife's real AI, exactly as a visitor's run would go. Free for the developer and not charged to anyone. Limited to 25 runs a day per developer. Every run is kept, with its inputs and answer, for the team to read at review, and at least one successful run of the exact version is required before it can be sent. Use realistic inputs (for doc apps: the sample), read the answer critically, and improve the instructions if it is wrong, generic or invents facts. Returns the full answer. For a file app with an AI step, pass inputs exactly as the page sends them to window.ezyourlife.ai(inputs); the answer is the parsed JSON or text the page would receive.

inputs.description: doc apps: the field values keyed by field key (strings; rows fields as arrays of objects). vision apps: an optional note under the key 'Extra instructions' (the pictures go in images).

messages.description: chat apps: the conversation so far; the last message must be from the user.

context.description: chat apps with documents: pasted document text.

images.description: vision apps: small pictures as data URLs, e.g. data:image/jpeg;base64,...

refine.description: doc apps: revise an earlier answer with an instruction such as 'Shorter'.

tools.name: dev_import_project
tools.title: Import a built app project from GitHub
tools.description: FILE APPS: imports the developer's whole built app, every file in its build folder (index.html with its JavaScript, CSS, images, fonts and data files; for Vite, React, Vue or Svelte this is dist/ after npm run build). Push that folder to a GitHub repo, then call this with the repo, the folder and the commit. The EzYourLife server reads every file, packs them into the form the store's sandbox runs (code-split pages, styles, pictures and data files keep working), stores it in the app's editable version and records the repo and commit. Then call dev_run_checks.

dir.description: The build folder inside the repo, e.g. "dist". Leave out if index.html is at the repo root.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit. Default main. A commit SHA pins exactly what you tested.

tools.name: dev_get_upload_link
tools.title: One-time upload link for a local app project
tools.description: FILE APPS, for Claude Code or any computer that can reach ezyourlife's database (also the way for private projects): returns a one-time key (valid 1 hour, one upload) and a Node script that packs a local build folder (index.html and every file it uses, for example dist/ after npm run build) exactly as dev_import_project does and sends it to the app's editable version. From a cloud workspace that can only reach GitHub, use dev_import_project.

folder.description: The local build folder you will send, e.g. dist. For the record and the command.

tools.name: dev_add_image
tools.title: Add a screenshot to a developer app's promo page
tools.description: Adds one real screenshot (png, jpeg or webp, under 400 KB, up to 6 per version) to the app's editable version. Give a public https link, a file in a public GitHub repo, or base64 data. If the latest version is live this starts the next version; the live app does not change until it is approved. Saving clears earlier check results. Only real screenshots of the app: never made-up or mock pictures.

url.description: Public https link to the picture.

github.description: A picture in a PUBLIC GitHub repo (owner/name, path, branch or commit).

base64.description: The picture as base64 (no data: prefix). Under 400 KB before encoding.

caption.description: What the picture shows, in plain words.

tools.name: dev_remove_image
tools.title: Remove a screenshot from a developer app
tools.description: Removes one screenshot (by image_id from dev_get_status) from the app's editable version. Clears earlier check results.

tools.name: dev_run_checks
tools.title: Run EzYourLife's checks on a developer app
tools.description: Runs the server-side checks on the app's latest version. File apps: the packed app, size, phone fit, keys and passwords, AI calls, own payments, outside addresses, browser storage, listing, name, promo, screenshots and similar apps. AI apps: the definition and its fields, instructions, secrets, a successful test run, listing, name, promo, screenshots and similar apps. Returns each result; 'fail' items must be fixed before submitting. Similar apps without a similar_note in the listing are a 'fail'; with a note they are shown to the admin as 'look'.

tools.name: dev_get_preview_link
tools.title: Get the live preview link for a developer app
tools.description: Returns the preview link for the app's latest version. The developer opens it while signed in to ezyourlife.com to try the real app as it will look on the site, on a phone-sized or desktop-sized screen. File apps run in the same sandbox the store uses; AI apps run on the real screens and AI (a limited number of free test runs a day). No credits are used.

tools.name: dev_submit_for_review
tools.title: Send a developer app for EzYourLife review
tools.description: Sends the latest version to the EzYourLife admin queue. Only works after the checks passed on this exact file. Ask the developer before calling it. The version is locked while it waits.

tools.name: dev_get_status
tools.title: Status and review feedback for a developer app
tools.description: Returns every version of the app with its state, the team's requested changes, the charge options and similar_note the developer gave, whether it is live and its live address, and the credits per use, per-option credits and share set by the team.
